response.reason: The cited clause (Art. 9(1)(a)) requires the name of the food to be provided, which supports the part of the verdict about the product having a legal or descriptive name. However, the verdict also claims compliance with the QUID (quantitative ingredient declaration) requirement for named ingredients. The QUID requirement is established in Art. 9(1)(d) and further detailed in Art. 22, not in Art. 9(1)(a). Therefore, the clause cited is insufficient to support the full verdict, as it does not establish the QUID requirement.
